bio.text: Alma S. Adams has represented North Carolina's 12th Congressional District in the U.S. House since winning a special election in November 2014; she was elected to a sixth full term in November 2024.
She served ten terms in the North Carolina House of Representatives after being appointed in 1994, and earlier served nine years on the Greensboro City Council.
She taught art at Bennett College for 40 years.
